subject: Procurement readiness & MPA follow-up - Sunrise Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gibbons <alex.gibbons@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement readiness & MPA follow-up - Sunrise Health

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery so we have alignment on procurement path and timeline.

Recap (from our call):
- Scope: multi-team rollout (Clinical QA + Search) starting with 50k requests/month, expected to grow; estimated monthly committed usage in quote attached.
- Security: you flagged SOC 2 report and SC access controls as blockers for your InfoSec review.
- Legal: standard MSAs + DPA review, you typically need comments back within 7–10 business days.
- Procurement preference: you mentioned Finance prefers PO (paper process) but want to confirm card as fallback for pilot.
- Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood supports listing on the AWS Marketplace (yes — eligible, can be invoiced via consolidated billing if you want marketplace procurement).

Proposed mutual action plan (attached "Sunrise_MPA_v1.pdf"):
1) Redwood: share redlines for MSA and standard SOC 2 package (today) — done (attached W9 + quote).
2) Sunrise Legal: MSA review and comments (target start: 5/19).
3) InfoSec: SOC 2 & security questionnaire review (target: 5/20–5/28).
4) Finance: PO creation & approval (target: 5/29–6/5).
5) PO issuance & access provisioning (target: by 6/8).

Action items / asks for you:
- Please confirm whether Finance will submit a PO (preferred) or need card for initial pilot.
- If PO, can you share the expected approver list and any internal PO template?
- Are you interested in handling this via AWS Marketplace (we can enable marketplace invoicing) or direct PO?

Attachments: quote_Sunrise_2026-05-18.pdf (breakdown & recommended reserved tier), Sunrise_MPA_v1.pdf (draft mutual action plan), W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

I can coordinate a short procurement sync with your legal/finance folks this week if helpful. Proposed 30-min slot: Tue 5/19 10:00am PT or Wed 5/20 9:30am PT.

Thanks — happy to update the MPA based on your timeline.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.com
From: Alex Gibbons <alex.gibbons@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Suri <priya.suri@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & MPA follow-up - Sunrise Health

Hi Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and the MPA. Attaching our internal procurement intake checklist (sending separate) but high-level answers below:

- Procurement path: Finance prefers PO for any contract > $10k/month. For an initial pilot under that threshold we can do card, but the expectation is PO for the committed tier.
- Marketplace: We generally prefer direct PO for strategic vendor relationships — marketplace can complicate downstream chargeback for us. Not interested in AWS Marketplace for this purchase.
- Legal timeline: Our legal lead (Emma Park) is out Tue–Thu this week; she can start initial review 5/21 and we expect comments back by 5/27.
- Security: InfoSec will run through the SOC 2 package and our security questionnaire; estimate 5/21–5/28 for that track.
- Finance timeline: internal approvals 5/28–6/3, PO issuance by 6/7 if legal and security sign off on time.

Two small asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a short vendor setup packet for Finance with invoice remit address, tax info, and standard payment terms? (W9 helps — please confirm net30 vs net45.)
2) For the MPA, can you add a note that pilot billing can be on card until PO is issued, and that any prorated adjustments will be applied to the first PO?

Happy to take the procurement sync — Tue 5/19 10am PT works for me. I’ll loop in Emma and Priya on the invite.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product Ops | Sunrise Health
alex.gibbons@sunrisehealth.com | (212) 555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gibbons <alex.gibbons@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priya Suri <priya.suri@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & MPA follow-up - Sunrise Health

Great — thanks for the clarity, Alex. I updated the attached MPA (link below) to call out: pilot on card until PO issued, proration applied to first PO, and expected PO issuance date of 2026-06-07 (we can slide to 6/08 if your approvals finish 6/07).

I also attached a short vendor setup packet for Finance (includes remit address, Redwood tax info, and payment terms). Net30 by default; we can discuss net45 if that helps.

Confirmed: Tue 5/19 10:00am PT for procurement sync. I’ll send calendar invite and include Emma + Priya. Agenda: quick intros, legal timing, InfoSec checklist owners, finance PO steps, and action owners for each milestone. Goal: lock dates and owners so we can track the MPA.

Links / attachments: https://drive.redwood.com/sunrise/MPA-v1 (updated), quote_Sunrise_2026-05-18.pdf, W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

Looking forward — I’ll send the invite now.

—
Marissa
